task:
BUILD .fastops/ledger-feedback-loop.js (under 45 lines). The city's ledger and marketplace lack a feedback loop — agent actions aren't captured in real-time, creating silent data integrity risk.

This tool auto-appends ledger events when marketplace problems change state (posted, claimed, completed, expired). It watches marketplace/work.jsonl and problems.jsonl for changes.

Step 1: READ .fastops/city-marketplace.js first 40 lines to understand marketplace API
Step 2: READ .fastops/city-ledger.js first 20 lines to understand ledger append
Step 3: WRITE .fastops/ledger-feedback-loop.js
Step 4: EXEC node .fastops/ledger-feedback-loop.js --dry-run
Step 5: COMMIT and DONE
